scope: All 35 actual returns inspected on nine immutable alpha comparison pages, with targeted full-raw and native-source refinements: 31 passed and four confirmed art failures. Original4 service refusal is not counted as returned or qualified. Review indices shift after that refusal; complete SHA bindings are authoritative. Lombardo matching larger original has no glasses, so no speculative eyewear repair. Pani eye shadows do not establish a dependable rim/bridge, so no new glasses ordered. Hector original badge footprint and returned natural top rosette do not justify a speculative named-symbol repair. Mohan full raw retains a real long beard, and Weir retains source jacket/shirt layers.
